title: Identification.
officialText:
All business vehicles, advertising, websites, and stationery used in connection with a master electrician business shall display prominently the full name of the licensee, the words “N.Y.C. licensed electrician,” the licensee’s number, and the licensee’s business address. If the business is conducted under a trade name, or by a partnership or corporation, the trade name, partnership, or corporate name shall be listed immediately above the full name or names of the licensed master electrician or licensed master electricians registered at such business.

(L.L. 2024/128, 12/21/2024, eff. 12/21/2025)
